info.title: Brineomatic plugin API
info.description:
HTTP API exposed by the signalk-brineomatic-plugin. Used by the plugin's own webapp to discover which Brineomatic boards have the remote-access proxy enabled and which local port each one is served on.

Live watermaker data is *not* served here — it is published as Signal K deltas under `watermaker.<boardname>.*` and available through the standard Signal K API and streaming endpoints.

Board.title: Board
Board.description: A Brineomatic board with the remote-access proxy enabled.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the board, as configured in the plugin settings.

name.description: User-defined name reported by the board. Falls back to the configured host until the board has sent its config.

proxy_port.description: Local port on the Signal K server that this board's own web UI is proxied to. Reach the board at `<scheme>://<this server>:<proxy_port>/`.

state.description: Connection state of the plugin's websocket to the board.

get.description: Returns one entry per configured board that has the remote-access proxy enabled and running. Boards without the proxy enabled — and boards skipped because of a missing or duplicate proxy port — are not listed. Returns an empty array when the plugin is not started or no board has the proxy enabled.
